newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Malaysia's Pantai Healthcare FRN raised to $65 mln.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Pantai Healthcare FRN raised to $65 mln.

text.p: Pantai Healthcare (Cayman) Ltd's five-year floating rate notes issue has been raised to US$65 million from US$50 million, arranger Peregrine Fixed Income said on Friday.
The notes are guaranteed by Hospital Pantai Bhd.
They were issued at par to float at 140 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return to top-tier managers is 150 basis points.

Peregrine Fixed Income Ltd, Agricultural Bank of China Singapore branch, Commerzbank (South East Asia) Ltd, Societe Generale Singapore branch, Dresdner Bank AG Labuan branch, The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd offshore banking unit Labuan, Korea Long Term Credit Bank and Sakura Merchant Bank (Singapore) Ltd are lead managers.

Bank Of Taiwan Singapore Branch, Banca Commerciale Italiana Singapore Branch, Bank of Communications Singapore branch, Bayerische Vereinsbank AG Singapore branch, Chiao Tung Bank Co Ltd offshore banking branch, KEXIM International (Singapore) Ltd, Kredietbank N.V. Singapre branch, Rabobank Nederland Labuan branch, United Malayan Banking Corp Bhd Singapore branch, AFC Merchant Bank, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) TBK Singapore branch, Banque Paribas Labuan branch, Boram Bank, Fubon Commercial Bank offshore banking branch, Kookmin Bank Singapore Ltd (Merchant Bank), Malayan Banking Bhd Hong Kong branch and Schroders International Merchant Bankers Ltd are co-lead managers.

Grand Commercial Bank offshore banking branch, The Bank of East Asia Singapore branch, First Commercial Bank Singapore branch, the Kwangtung Provincial Bank Singapore branch and The Pacific Bank Bhd are managers.
